gloss: even; (〜さえ〜ば) as long as, if only

definitions.explanation: Marks an extreme case, implying that if even this is so, the less extreme cases certainly are. Often in negative or surprising statements; after a noun with a case particle it becomes でさえ, にさえ, とさえ.

definitions.gloss: as long as; if only (in 〜さえ〜ば)
definitions.explanation: With a conditional ば form, names the one thing that is enough for the result: if only this one condition is met, nothing else is needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧さえ⟦{飲|の}めなかった→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{子|こ}どもでさえ⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: It's something even a child knows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧さえ⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I was so busy that I didn't even have time to talk with my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧さえ⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I can go as long as I have the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧さえ⟦{飲|の}めば→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{治|なお}ります→治る：19598_naoru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you just take this medicine, you'll get better soon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{君|きみ}→君：01384_kimi⟧さえよければ、⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: If it's all right with you, let's go out together this weekend.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + さえ: even N (replaces ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ and ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)
- Noun + でさえ / ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さえ: even N, keeping the case particle
- Noun + さえ + Vば / Aければ / Nなら: as long as N
- Vます stem + さえ + ⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧: as long as one does V (⟦{謝|あやま}り→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧さえ⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧, as long as you apologise)
- Vて + さえ + ⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧: as long as one keeps doing V

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すら→すら：32260_sura⟧: even (written and literary); does not form the 〜さえ〜ば pattern
- ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: even, as far as (adds one more item to a list, often surprising: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧)
- ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: also, even; the lighter, everyday word ({一円|いちえん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧)
- ⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧: precisely (singles something out for emphasis, not as an extreme case)
